card.text: The Orion Nebula is a Milky Way H II region about 414 parsecs away.

sources.label: Menten et al. (2007), The distance to the Orion Nebula

introduction.text: The Orion Nebula is a Milky Way H II region about 414 parsecs away. Its bright gas surrounds the young Orion Nebula Cluster.

sources.label: Menten et al. (2007), The distance to the Orion Nebula

eso-optical.title: Orion in visible light
eso-optical.summary: Optical display colors on an inferred cloud; physical depth and faint outer structure remain uncertain.

eso-vista.title: Orion in near infrared
eso-vista.summary: Near-infrared false color on the same inferred cloud; the image does not measure its depth.
